The Challenge

MARKET ENTRY REQUIRES COMMERCIAL AND OPERATIONAL CLARITY.

A successful entry depends on the market, the right local relationships, trade and customs requirements, logistics and the operating environment. We connect these factors to define the practical steps required to enter and operate in Georgia.

The Region

GEORGIA AT THE CENTRE OF A WIDER TRADE NETWORK.

Georgia links the Black Sea with the Caucasus and Central Asia. Our work is Georgia-based and extends across the commercial and operational connections that link these markets with Europe.

Experience

BUILT ON 15 YEARS INSIDE GEORGIA’S TRADE ENVIRONMENT.

Shota Gelashvili

Founder & Business Architect

Before founding ARQITEQTURA GLOBAL, Shota Gelashvili spent 15 years within Georgia’s Ministry of Finance and Revenue Service, working across customs, ports, railways, airports, Customs Clearance Zones and logistics infrastructure.

The result is a Georgia-side perspective on how government, regulation, infrastructure, logistics and business operations work together in practice.
